items.reason: Gap 0 describes concurrent deliveries of the same event both passing the Set check before either records the ID.
Gap 1 identifies the deduplication identity as an unsigned X-Event-Id that can be altered independently of the signed body.
Gap 2 states that the provider uses charge.refunded while the registered refund handler uses refund.created, leaving refunds unhandled.
No gap depends on multiple processes, instances, or replicas.
